scope: Inspection of the native government source component, its roof and outline, and supported placement in the captured scene. Illustrative window rows are not surveyed facade or floor-count evidence. An individual source component does not establish complete landmark, shopping-centre or estate coverage. Unapproved landmark associations remain unapproved.
